mapper.select: select id, cfg_id, rules, remark, modedatacreater, modedatacreatedate, modedatacreatetime, modedatamodifier, modedatamodifydatetime from ${table} order by (case when cfg_id is null or cfg_id = 0 then 0 else cfg_id end), id
select top 1 id, cfg_id, rules from ${table} where cfg_id = #{cfgId} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into ${table} (cfg_id, rules, modedatacreater, modedatacreatedate, modedatacreatetime, modedatamodifier, modedatamodifydatetime) values (#{e.cfgId}, #{e.rules}, #{e.modedatacreater}, #{e.modedatacreatedate}, #{e.modedatacreatetime}, #{e.modedatamodifier}, #{e.modedatamodifydatetime})
